title: Nodia CV
intro: Organize your professional profiles and prepare résumés for your applications.
profiles_subtitle: Create or duplicate a profile to tailor your experience to different roles.
empty_profiles_description: Create a profile with your details and experience to use when preparing a résumé.
delete_profile_message: “{{name}}” will be deleted and unavailable for résumé generation. Saved résumé versions are kept.
review_delete_again: Close this confirmation and review the updated profile before deleting again.
generate_needs_profile: Create and save a profile to generate a draft.
versions_subtitle: Open, download or delete the PDFs you saved.
versions_empty_description: Prepare a PDF from a draft and save the version you want to keep.
version_delete_message: {{version}}, saved with the profile “{{profile}}”, will be deleted.
version_absent: The résumé is no longer available
version_save_uncertain: The save result is unconfirmed. Retry with the same PDF to recover this request.
idempotency_conflict: The save key belongs to a different request.
pdf_read_verified: Internal check verified on the exact PDF
pdf_read_server: Internal check completed by the server
pdf_read_summary_one: Selectable text was extracted from {{count}} page.
pdf_read_summary_other: Selectable text was extracted from {{count}} pages.
pdf_missing_contact: The PDF does not include a way to contact you.
pdf_external_import_pending: Import into an external ATS is pending verification.
pdf_view_failed: The viewer could not load. You can retry, read the extracted text or download the verified PDF.
pdf_integrity_failed: The received file does not match the verified PDF. Check the file again.
pdf_not_found: The PDF artifact is no longer available.
pdf_stale: The PDF review changed. Refresh the draft and prepare the PDF again.
pdf_busy: The renderer is busy. Wait a moment and retry.
pdf_timeout: Preparing or reading the PDF timed out.
pdf_limits: The content exceeds this template’s limit. Review the length of the draft.
pdf_render_failed: The PDF could not be prepared. Retry with the same draft.
pdf_read_failed: The prepared PDF could not be read.
pdf_no_text: The PDF has no readable text layer.
pdf_text_mismatch: The extracted text differs from the document. Review the draft content.
pdf_layout_invalid: The PDF layout failed its internal check.
access_lost: Your access to Nodia CV changed. Reopen the module if you have access.

personal.profile_name: Choose a name that helps you tell this profile apart, such as “Senior Frontend Developer”.
personal.full_name: Enter your full name as you want it to appear on your CV.
personal.professional_title: Enter your specialty or the main role you are targeting, such as “Frontend Developer”.
personal.second_title: Add a relevant complementary specialty, such as “Full-stack Development”.
personal.summary: Summarize your experience, specialty and key strengths in one paragraph.
personal.main_stack: List the main technologies in your profile, one per line, such as React or TypeScript.

contact.location: Enter the city and country you want to show on your CV.
contact.email: Enter the email address where you want to receive messages about job applications.
contact.phone: Enter the number where you can be reached, including the country dialing code.
contact.linkedin_url: Paste the full link to your public LinkedIn profile.
contact.github_url: Paste the full link to your GitHub profile.
contact.portfolio_url: Paste the link to the site where you showcase your projects or work.

experiences.company: Enter the name of the company or organization where you worked.
experiences.position: Enter the job title you held in this role.
experiences.location: Enter the city and country where you worked, or “Remote” if applicable.
experiences.status: Choose “Current” if you still hold the role, “Finished” if it ended, or “Unspecified” to omit it.
experiences.start_month: Enter the year and month you started the job, for example 2024-06.
experiences.end_month: Enter the year and month the job ended. Leave it blank if the role is current.
experiences.highlights: Enter one responsibility, contribution or achievement per line. Include concrete results you can substantiate.
experiences.technologies: List the technologies and tools you used in this job, one per line.

projects.name: Enter the name you want to use for the project on your CV.
projects.role: Enter your role or the part of the project you worked on.
projects.status: Describe the project's status, such as “In development”, “Published” or “Finished”.
projects.start_month: Enter the year and month you started working on the project, for example 2025-02.
projects.end_month: Enter when the project ended. Leave it blank if the project is still underway.
projects.url: Paste a link others can open, such as a demo or public repository.
projects.validation_context: Describe the problem the project solves, who it serves and how you used or tested it.
projects.contributions: Describe what you did on the project, one contribution per line.
projects.technologies: List the languages, tools or services you used for the project, one per line.

skill_areas.name: Name this group of skills, such as “Frontend” or “Databases”.
skill_areas.skills: Enter one skill from this area per line, such as “Data modeling” or “PostgreSQL”.

education.title: Enter the name of the degree, qualification or program you studied.
education.institution: Enter the name of the institution where you studied.
education.start_year: Enter the year you started your studies, for example 2020.
education.end_year: Enter the year you finished your studies. Leave it blank if they are still in progress.
education.details: Add a specialization, distinction or academic achievement relevant to your CV.

certifications.name: Enter the name as it appears on the certificate.
certifications.issuer: Enter the organization that issued the certification.
certifications.year: Enter the year the certificate was issued.
certifications.credential_id: Enter the credential code or number, if the issuer provided one.
certifications.verification_url: Paste the link where the credential can be verified, if available.

languages.language: Enter the language you want to include, such as English or Portuguese.
languages.level: Enter your actual proficiency. You can use a level such as B2 or a description such as “Native”.
languages.usage: Explain how you use the language, such as in meetings or when reading technical documentation.

additional_sections.title: Name the extra section, such as “Volunteering” or “Publications”.
additional_sections.lines: Add one item per line, with enough context for the reader to understand it.

discard_confirm: Changes in this form will be lost if you leave.
discard_uncertain: The server may have saved the profile. If you leave, check the list before creating it again.
uncertain_create: The save result is unconfirmed. Retry the same save to check the outcome.
reload_profile_description: Your changes are still here. Loading the current profile will replace the values in this form.
profile_not_found: This profile is no longer available.
stale_profile: The profile changed in another session. Review the current version before saving again.
request_key_conflict: The request matches a different operation.
request_closed: The save request is already closed.
invalid_profile_dates: Check the date order and leave the end date blank for current jobs.
invalid_profile_entry: Review the profile entries. One or more entries no longer match the saved version.
profile_too_large: This profile is too large. Shorten the text sections before saving.
invalid_input: Review the profile details and try again.
rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
request_failed: The request could not be completed.

validation.length: This text exceeds the allowed length.
validation.url: Enter a link starting with http:// or https://.
validation.rows: Add up to 25 entries in this section.
validation.lines: Enter up to 30 items, one per line.

generation_profile_unavailable: The selected profile is no longer available.
generation_preview_empty: Your draft will appear here when generation finishes.
generation_previous_draft: This draft belongs to the previous request.
generation_requirements_empty: The draft contains no identified requirements.
generation_failed: The draft could not be prepared. You can generate again when ready.
generation_unknown_help: The provider may have processed this request. The uncertain outcome was retained and the request will not be sent again.
generation_admission_uncertain: The response was lost. Check the receipt to recover this request.
generation_receipt_missing: There is no visible receipt yet. You can send the same request again with its original key.

generation_failure.generation_invalid_output: The response did not pass validation. Review the job posting and generate again.
generation_failure.stale_profile: The profile changed during generation. Review it and generate from the current revision.
generation_failure.generation_queue_deadline: The request expired before starting. You can generate again.
generation_failure.configuration_unavailable: The connection changed. Review your AI selection.
generation_failure.generation_configuration_changed: The selection changed. Apply it again before generating.

review_declaration_help: Add only facts you can confirm. Identify the job, project, education or other source.
review_evidence_pair: Enter both the source and the evidence to save your addition.
review_reload_help: Check the latest revision to keep your edits and refresh the fields you left unchanged.
review_reloaded: Revision updated. Check the source and contribution before confirming.

model_selector.title: AI settings
model_selector.choose: Choose a connection and model to continue
model_selector.unsaved: Unapplied changes. Apply or cancel them before generating a draft.
model_selector.scope: This selection applies to the next draft.
model_selector.agentic_transport_unavailable: Agentic is not yet available for résumé generation.
model_selector.agentic_host_unavailable: The Codex host for résumés is unavailable.
model_selector.configuration_unavailable: This connection or selection is not configured for résumé generation.
model_selector.codex_session_required: Connect your Codex account in AI settings.
model_selector.codex_session_unverified: The Codex session could not be verified. Check it again.
model_selector.codex_model_unavailable: The selected model is unavailable on this Codex connection.
model_selector.codex_effort_unavailable: The selected reasoning level is unavailable for this model.
model_selector.codex_profile_busy: The Codex connection is in use. Check it again when it is free.
model_selector.codex_usage_unavailable: This Codex account cannot generate right now.
model_selector.qualification_required: This exact selection is not yet enabled for résumé generation.
model_selector.qualified: This selection is enabled for draft generation.
model_selector.selection_unavailable: This selection is unavailable for résumé generation.
model_selector.no_connections: No AI connections are available for résumé generation.
model_selector.selection_missing: This selection is no longer in the catalog. Review it before continuing.

generation_expired: The draft expired or its profile was deleted.
generation_invalid_input: Review the profile and job posting before generating.
generation_input_too_large: The posting or profile exceeds the size available for draft generation.
generation_queue_busy: The generation service is busy. Try again later.
generation_selection_unqualified: This AI selection is not yet enabled for Nodia CV.
agentic_transport_unavailable: Agentic is not yet available for résumé generation.
configuration_unavailable: The AI connection is unavailable for this selection.
invalid_cursor: The next catalog page could not be loaded.
connection_catalog_too_large: The catalog exceeds the supported size.
draft_not_ready: The draft is not yet ready to review.
stale_draft: The draft changed since you opened the review.
invalid_draft_review: Review the selected facts and the evidence you entered.
generation_restore_saved: This tab has a previous request. You can recover its posting and draft.
